rules._comment: Non-tanks fight from the rear flank and dodge ground AoE. (Replaces the C++ MaexxnaTrigger's non-tank gate with role:nontank.)

DPS swap onto the off-threat Web Wrap cocoon (entry 16486 / name 'web wrap') the instant one spawns to free the wrapped player, then fall back to the boss. attack with detect:nearest scans nearby NPCs by name/entry because the default threat detection can't see an off-threat cocoon. +2 beats default attacker selection so the bot leaves the boss.

Sub-30% Frenzy Web Spray (29484, raid-wide stun every 40s, first at 40s): pre-cast tank externals/defensives in the 4s window before it so they carry through the stun (healers are stunned too, so reactive healing can't). pre_cast_window predicts the 40s cadence and re-anchors on the observed stun aura. Each cast self-gates to its class, so only the right bot acts; require_aura:frenzy keeps it to the lethal frenzied sprays.

actions.name: hand of sacrifice on main tank
